title: The one-box filing spec passes five times in a row on two busy cores
description: browser-tests/create-work-one-box.spec.ts runs five times in a row pinned to two CPU cores shared with four busy loops, and every run passes: a dashboard poll still in flight when the spec tears down its API proxy no longer holds the teardown open until the test timeout.

steps.name: the one-box spec, five runs, on two busy cores
steps.run: taskset -c 0,1 sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4; do node -e "for(;;);" & busy="$busy $!"; done; npm run test:browser -- browser-tests/create-work-one-box.spec.ts --repeat-each 5 --workers 1; status=$?; kill $busy; exit $status'
